title: Spacewalk 101
description: NASA flight director Mike Lammers provides an overview of spacewalks, also known as extravehicular activities. A spacewalk is any excursion outside a spacecraft. Aboard the International Space Station, astronauts perform spacewalks wearing the Extravehicular Mobility Unit, or spacesuit, to complete maintenance and upgrade activities. Astronauts often train for spacewalks at NASA’s Neutral Buoyancy Laboratory in Houston. Learn more about International Space Station research and operations at: https://www.nasa.gov/station jsc2026m000932
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
